RBI Generalist programme carries no product wording in the title
user asked for operations and marketing internships too
rotational FT programme carries no internship wording; expected to open 2026-09-14

_canada_comment: canada:true marks boards observed to carry Canadian postings. `scan --region ca` uses only these, which is what makes the 20-minute Canadian cadence affordable.
